every_position_composed.reason: Site 1 clears the overlay card completely during camera transitions in frames 4 and 7 to show the full 3D machine unobstructed, whereas Site 2 leaves a dark, faded, nearly empty card blocking the left machine in frame 4.

explains_the_project.reason: Both sites use the exact same 3D factory metaphor—pressing a 302,628-token slab in frame 3 into a bounded digest in frame 5, routing to an anchor rack in frame 6, and gating 7 host lanes in frame 8.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Both sites render the identical 3D scene with the same beveled industrial machinery, grid floor, lighting, and shadows across frames 1 through 9.

type_and_layout.reason: Site 1 cleanly hides text cards between scroll stops in frames 4 and 7, while Site 2 displays low-contrast, barely legible faded text inside dark boxes in frames 4 and 7.

overall.reason: While both sites share the same strong 3D visualization and typography, Site 1 handles scroll transitions cleanly without leaving faded, unreadable card overlays obstructing the 3D scene.
